Quick answers

How do I place an order?

Tap "Order on WhatsApp" on any product page, or message us the product name and your delivery pincode. We confirm the total and delivery time, and you can pay online or choose Cash on Delivery.

How long does delivery take?

Shipping is free, and most orders arrive in 3 to 7 days anywhere in India.

Which cream should I choose?

Take the two-minute skin quiz, or tell us your skin type on WhatsApp and we will suggest one.
